neighbours.label: Python code that takes exactly one element out of a collection: the '1' in 'len(x) == 1', the '[0]' after a filter, and ' next(' on an iterator; the + pole is the other side (whole-collection operations such as .all(), set(), union)

notes: Card peaks: '0' x12, '1' x9, ' next' x7, '.first'. Probes: assert len == 1 with [0] 1.00, next(iter()) 0.87, sum() 0.01. Near misses include other counts and indexes (== 4, [-1]) to test 'one/first' rather than 'a number after len'.
